result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues are present: restaurant names and category chips are truncated, and the bottom promotional card is cut off by the navigation bar.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card label is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of showing the full restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Allow card titles to wrap to two lines, reduce font size, or widen cards so full names remain visible.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotional card is partially cut off by the fixed bottom tab bar, hiding part of the image and content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scrollable content so cards are fully visible above the tab bar.

issues.description: The horizontal category chip row is clipped on the right, with the next category only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scrolling is obvious (e.g., fade edge or peek of next chip) or fit chips without abrupt cutoff.

issues.description: Delivery fee text under 'Fastest near you' cards uses a very light gray that is hard to read against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast of secondary text (darker gray) to improve readability.
